body:
Not sure this is the right approach. What this will do is keep displaying the last results when people will use backspace to delete their search term (because we won't fire a search on the empty query, so the last results will still be here).

I feel that what is needed for the linked use case is more a way of disabling the initial `search()` on the instantsearch instanciation. Something like `searchOnInit: false`. The search would then only be started on the first keystroke.
